task.title: Installation process
task.shortdesc: Follow the steps in the order presented.

prereq.p: Before you begin, ensure the following prerequisites are met:

ul.li: SNMP is enabled on the network.

step.cmd: Download the installer package: Obtain from one of the approved sources previously mentioned.

substep.cmd: Automatic detection: Run the installer to detect compatible printers automatically on the network.
Manual configuration: If detection fails, enter the device IP address manually for setup.

step.cmd: Printer queue setup: Confirm the printer queue for proper print job alignment within Windows.
If the autodiscovery did not find the device, continue by adding the device manually

cmd.b: Set up the print server on Windows Server 2019:

substep.cmd: Open the Server Manager and select 'Add roles and features'.
Choose 'Role-based or feature-based installation' and click 'Next'.
Select the server from the server pool and click 'Next'.
Under 'Server Roles', select 'Print and Document Services' and click 'Next'.
Proceed through the wizard to complete the installation.

cmd.b: Set up the print server on Windows Server 2022:

substep.cmd: Open the Server Manager and select 'Add roles and features'.
Choose 'Role-based or feature-based installation' and click 'Next'.
Select the server from the server pool and click 'Next'.
Under 'Server Roles', select 'Print and Document Services' and click 'Next'.
Proceed through the wizard to complete the installation.

note.p: If you encounter issues with SNMP or bi-directionality, refer to the troubleshooting sections.
